decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a versatile and durable backpack. My consideration set includes a large 70L frame pack for major trips, a 45L tactical bag for high-capacity daily use, a budget-friendly 40L daypack, a technical 28L hiking pack, and a specialized cooler backpack. I decided to purchase the QT&QY 45L Tactical Backpack because its combination of high ratings (4.7), large number of reviews (over 6,000), and robust military-style design represents the best value for a multi-purpose pack at the $39.99 price point.
